race.comment: SQUAZEEMOTO (9) is a key chance after making a decisive first-up return at Moe, beating Laura's Gold by a length and a half. He's a 10yo veteran but that was a good win and he sets up for every chance again. CARIBBEAN VILLA (2) brings the most consistent recent BM62 form, with a neck second at Horsham followed by a Swan Hill third when grabbed late. Consistent and will take beating in this. FOX MAN (1) resumes from five months off with a Horsham trial win behind him, wary for the Meech/Bobbin combination. FROSE (8) is a fringe chance on best form.
